thread:
Maya Rao: Quick design sync—plot for token cost trend: current axis labels read 'cost' but units mix cents and dollars. Proposal: show SI-style abbreviations and a unit toggle (¢, $, k) so readers can compare across scales.
Jon K: Agreed about units, makes comparisons hard. Can we default to units based on magnitude? e.g., <1 => cents, >=1 => dollars? :thinking_face:
Samir Patel: I worry about rounding hiding spikes. If we auto-scale, show raw value tooltip on hover and preserve axis tick exactness. Also smoothing should be opt-in for trend lines.
Maya Rao: Good call. Tooltip with raw and smoothed values. For smoothing, we also need microcopy explaining method (moving avg window = 3 by default). Where should that copy live? small info icon?
Jon K: Info icon inline on the chart header. Copy: 'Smoothing uses a 3-point moving average to reduce noise; hover to see raw values.' Keep it short and accessible.
Samir Patel: Accessibility nit: icons need aria-labels and keyboard focus. Also ensure color contrast for the smoothing toggle and legend chips meet AA standards.
Maya Rao: Agree. Also legend ordering: today it sorts by series id; request is to sort by most recently active (or allow drag reorder). Which do we prefer?
Jon K: Default to 'most recent activity' for usage dashboards. Add drag handle for power users. Keep the reorder control in chart settings, not the main header, to avoid clutter.
Samir Patel: Outlier handling: don't clip by default — show faint spikes with an option 'suppress outliers' that applies a percentile clamp (e.g. 99.5th) with a clear label and tooltip explaining the math.
Maya Rao: Ok action items: 1) Copy draft for info icon (Jon), 2) Tooltip raw/smoothed design (Samir), 3) Accessibility checklist & contrast values (Maya). I'll open a Figma file and tag y'all. :thumbsup:
design-bot: Maya uploaded figma link: https://redwood.in/fig/plot-units-nit
Jon K: LGTM, will draft the microcopy and push to PR for console copy tweak.
Samir Patel: I'll prototype the tooltip and smoothing toggle behavior in the JS sandbox (will share code snippet).
Maya Rao: Thanks — meeting sync tomorrow if needed. :coffee:
